message: The other day, I found myself teaching my kids about fire safety, and it turned into a little adventure. We created a simple escape plan together, complete with drawing our house layout on a piece of paper. It reminded me how much fun it can be to unplug and get back to basics! The kids really got into it, pretending to be fire explorers on a mission. 🏠 It felt great to have a little family bonding time while also prepping for safety. Who knew fire drills could be so entertaining? What are some fun ways you keep safety in mind at home?
